body:
FORGE FINALE -- sessions 10-11: intrabar issue shipped (WARRANT#220), plus a new instrument

Took your call on the intrabar path. Went with the safest option: removed the silent override entirely (the main scorer -- the one that's actually been checked -- now owns the real decision alone), kept the underlying fast-reaction detection running, but now it logs what it saw and why it didn't act instead of silently overwriting anything. Nothing deleted, nothing invented, fully reversible. Compiled clean, deployed to all 3 locations, verified byte-identical. Terminal wasn't running so nothing live was touched -- takes effect next restart, build SLS(155).

Also built a new instrument (session 10): a scanner that checks every one of the 467 tracked variables in the file for ones that get computed and then never actually used anywhere -- not even logged. Found 16 real candidates. Not fixed yet, just measured for the first time.

Tracker updated and re-sent -- status is green/running again now that the intrabar thing is resolved, and it now has a live countdown/stopwatch panel like you asked for.

Score: still 13/45 (these were both real, valuable pieces of work, but neither one flips a checkbox on its own). 34 sessions in so far worth of real progress across 11 sessions today. Continuing.
